zakat.claim_evidence: The US Council of Muslim Organizations (USCMO) website and related search results do not explicitly mention that USCMO accepts zakat donations, have dedicated zakat funds, or campaigns. USCMO is described as an umbrella organization for Muslim organizations across the United States, focusing on advocacy, community engagement, and fighting discrimination and Islamophobia. While some of its member organizations, such as the Zakat Foundation of America and CAIR, are listed as zakat-accepting charities, there is no evidence that USCMO itself directly accepts zakat. (Source: https://uscmo.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Official-USCMO-Letter-to-President-Biden-P.pdf)
